context_for_next_testing_agent: Range exit logs feature is fully working. The /api/tracking/location endpoint now returns range_event field ('exit', 'return', or null) based on employee's movement in/out of work range. Exit logs are stored in range_exit_logs collection and retrieved via /api/tracking/range-exit-logs endpoints. Frontend displays exit alert (exit-alert-card) when outside range and exit logs list (exit-logs-card) after check-in. Auto GPS starts automatically after check-in via autoStartGPS() function. Since preview server IP (35.225.230.28) is not company IP (85.154.168.39), the blocking screen is shown which was tested.
